div.head: Leis Wl 20.4
div.ab: [Cil qui tenent lur terre a cense, so[i]t lur dreit relief a tant cum la cense est de un an.]
[For those who hold their land by the payment of rent the legal heriot shall be the equivalent of a year's rent.]
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 262–263 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added; From I, where it comes after 38 (not in Hk); Robertson follows the order of L.
